options.name: Farr Park RV Campground (BREC)
options.priceNote: No-hookup/dry camping ~$10/night per recent reviews; full-hookup RV sites $35/night + tax. Tent use on grass reported by campers but confirm by phone.
options.locationNote: 6402 River Road, Baton Rouge (EAST bank), directly on the Mississippi levee bike path ~10-12 mi south of the US-190 bridge bike crossing. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Public parish (BREC) recreation facility; phone reservations only, 14-night max.
options.cyclistIntel: Dyrt reviews note a paved levee bike path runs directly from the campground toward the capital; popular with riders doing River Road. Bathhouse with 4 showers per side.

options.name: B & B RV Park
options.priceNote: Nightly rate not published (weekly $150 ≈ $21/night; monthly $560). Long-term-oriented park; tent acceptance NOT verified — call before counting on it.
options.locationNote: 100 Bellina Dr, Donaldsonville — in town, ~1 mi off the levee route. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established private RV park since 1980; laundromat and hookups confirmed, bathhouse/showers not confirmed.
options.cyclistIntel: Only overnight facility inside Donaldsonville itself; no cyclist journal mentions found.

options.name: Cajun Country Campground (Port Allen)
options.priceNote: RV sites ~$40; tent sites offered per RV LIFE/Yelp listings but tent rate unpublished — estimate $25-30, confirm by phone. Phone-only reservations.
options.locationNote: 4667 Rebelle Ln, Port Allen — west bank, just off the US-190 corridor near the Baton Rouge bridge crossing. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established private campground; bathhouse and laundry on site.
options.cyclistIntel: Best-positioned legit tent campground between Donaldsonville and St. Francisville; sits basically on the corridor where the route crosses the Mississippi.

options.name: Poche Plantation RV Resort
options.priceNote: From $45/night, RVs ONLY — no tent camping allowed. Listed only so you don't route to it; cottages $119-139 if desperate.
options.locationNote: 6554 LA-44 (River Road), Convent — EAST bank, ~9 mi behind Donaldsonville via the Sunshine Bridge.
options.legalityNote: Private resort; explicitly no tents.
options.cyclistIntel: Sometimes suggested to MRT riders but useless for a tent tourer.

gapAdvice: Donaldsonville has NO verified tent camping. Realistic plays: (1) call B&B RV Park about pitching a tent; (2) ask at a Donaldsonville church or the police department about Crescent Park/Louisiana Square — classic Louisiana small-town move but unverified here; (3) restructure days 6-7 so the overnight lands at Port Allen (Cajun Country CG, mile ~437) or Farr Park ($10 dry camp) — both verified, ~35 route mi past Donaldsonville, which shortens Day 7 into St. Francisville to ~30 mi. Water/food resupply in Donaldsonville is good either way.

options.name: Tunica Hills WMA primitive campground (South Tract)
options.priceNote: Free camping, but ages 16-59 must carry a LA hunting/fishing license or Wild Louisiana Stamp, plus free self-clearing permit at the kiosk.
options.locationNote: Tent-only field off Parker Rd, South Tract, ~14 hilly mi NW of St. Francisville via US-61/LA-66/Old Tunica Rd. Off-route spur; coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Legal designated primitive camping area on LDWF land; porta-potties only, carry all water.
options.cyclistIntel: Known as Louisiana's primitive-camping gem; the stamp requirement trips people up — buy online before the trip.
options.seasonalNote: Late Sept: check LDWF for early hunting-season activity.

options.name: Tunica Hills Campground (private)
options.priceNote: Tent non-electric $20/night (2 people), electric $25; +$10 single-night surcharge +14% tax — expect ~$34 for one night. CASH ONLY.
options.locationNote: 12112-12238 Parker Rd, ~15 mi NW of St. Francisville (same off-route spur as the WMA). Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established private campground; 20 sites with tent pads, hot-water showerhouse, pavilion with grill/microwave.
options.cyclistIntel: Best legit tent camping in the St. Francisville area now that Green Acres is gone; small A-frame cabin $65 as a rain bailout.

options.name: Shelby J's RV Park
options.priceNote: Rates not published; small locally-owned park, 30/50A + laundry. Tent acceptance unverified — ask; rural LA parks often say yes.
options.locationNote: 14189 LA-10, ~3.5 mi west of US-61 — essentially ON the route toward the Audubon Bridge. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established RV park in West Feliciana Parish; amenities beyond hookups/laundry unconfirmed.
options.cyclistIntel: Same owner also runs Tunica Trace RV Park (13155 Tunica Trace, LA-66).

options.name: Peaceful Pines RV Park (formerly Green Acres Campground)
options.priceNote: WARNING — OSM hint is stale for tenters: website states 'We do not offer tent camping at the RV park.' Nightly rates unpublished (monthly-focused). Do NOT plan on this or on 'Green Acres' (same place, renamed).
options.locationNote: 11907 LA-965, 2.9 mi off route. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Explicitly no tents.
options.cyclistIntel: Older journals mention Green Acres; that option effectively no longer exists for tents.

options.name: Jim's Camping Area (False River)
options.priceNote: No-frills waterside campground; tents and RVs accepted per Campendium/Country Roads; rate unpublished — estimate $15-25, cash/cards.
options.locationNote: 7913 Park St, north end of False River (New Roads/Ventress), ~11 route mi AHEAD of St. Francisville across the Audubon Bridge. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established commercial campground with bar & grill and boat launch; shower situation unverified.
options.cyclistIntel: Matches the OSM 'Jim's Place mi 480.6' hint; hot food on site is a plus.

gapAdvice: The two Tunica Hills options are a serious 14-15 mi hilly detour NW; if you want to stay on-line, either call Shelby J's about a tent spot near the bridge or push 11 mi to Jim's Camping Area on False River.

options.name: Morganza church/community ask
options.priceNote: Free with permission.
options.locationNote: Tiny levee town (pop ~600) on LA-1 at the Morganza Spillway.
options.legalityNote: Only with explicit permission from a church or town hall — standard rural-Louisiana courtesy stop, not verified for this town specifically.
options.cyclistIntel: No specific journal record found for Morganza; treat as fallback if Maxey Care won't take a tent.

options.name: Jim's Camping Area (False River)
options.priceNote: Tents accepted; rate unpublished — estimate $15-25. 10 route mi BEFORE Morganza.
options.locationNote: 7913 Park St, north end of False River near New Roads. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established commercial campground; bar & grill on site.
options.cyclistIntel: Stopping here shortens Day 8 by 10 mi and lengthens the already-hard Day 9 — better paired with a Yellow Bayou/Simmesport overnight.

options.name: Maxey Care RV Park and Campground
options.priceNote: Rate unpublished — estimate $30-35 RV; tent acceptance unverified but it markets itself as 'RV Park and Campground' with a bathhouse — call.
options.locationNote: 641 S LA-1, Morganza — 0.1 mi off the endpoint per OSM. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established private park; bathrooms with showers, coin laundry, 24-hr on-site managers confirmed. 2BR cabin available (sleeps 4) as bailout.
options.cyclistIntel: The only facility at the Day 8 endpoint; covered pavilion useful in rain.

bestBet: Maxey Care RV Park and Campground
gapAdvice: Call Maxey Care in advance about tents (225-694-3929); if no, Jim's at mile 480.6 is the verified-tent fallback.

options.name: Yellow Bayou Civil War Memorial Park
options.priceNote: Historically free/nominal camping for Southern Tier riders (the pre-2018 ST ran through Simmesport); CURRENT camping permission unverified — only picnic facilities are documented today. Call Avoyelles tourism (318) 964-2025 before relying on it.
options.locationNote: 15602 LA-1, ~1.5 mi east of Simmesport near the Atchafalaya bridge; ~4 mi before the Day 9 endpoint. Coordinates approximate (HMDB marker).
options.legalityNote: Public memorial park managed via Avoyelles Commission of Tourism; get explicit OK. Restroom/water status unknown — assume none and carry water.
options.cyclistIntel: Multiple CGOAB ST journals (2007, 2014, 2017) overnight in Simmesport; Yellow Bayou was the traditional stop on the old ACA alignment.
options.seasonalNote: Low, buggy ground near the bayou in late Sept.

options.name: Simmesport church yard / town-hall ask
options.priceNote: Free with permission.
options.locationNote: Simmesport town center, LA-1 — ~2.5 mi before the Day 9 endpoint.
options.legalityNote: Ask at a church, the police department, or town hall; town saw regular cross-country cyclists for decades on the old ST alignment.
options.cyclistIntel: CGOAB journals ending in Simmesport (e.g. 'Southern Tier 2014: Day 47', 'Southern Tier 2017: Day 49') confirm it as the standard overnight town for this stretch.

bestBet: Yellow Bayou Civil War Memorial Park
gapAdvice: Genuinely anchor-less: no verified commercial campground within the flex window. Plan to sleep in/near Simmesport (mile ~525) rather than the literal mile-527 endpoint. Pre-trip, call Avoyelles tourism (318-964-2025) to confirm Yellow Bayou camping; on the day, top off water in Simmesport (last services). Paid fallbacks are all off-route: Marksville (17 mi N, motels + Paragon Casino RV Resort — RV-oriented, tents doubtful). Avoid Atchafalaya-area WMA land unless you've bought the Wild Louisiana Stamp and confirmed a designated camping area — most nearby WMA ground is seasonal-hunt land with no designated sites on the route.

options.name: Mamou city ball field / church yard (police-arranged)
options.priceNote: Free with permission from Mamou PD/town hall.
options.locationNote: Mamou town center — the Day 10 endpoint.
options.legalityNote: Only via explicit permission — precedent exists: a 2007 CGOAB Southern Tier journal records the police dispatcher setting tourers up at the local ball field.
options.cyclistIntel: Mamou (Fred's Lounge town) is a long-standing ST waypoint; journals also warn the local RV campground felt sketchy — go through the police, not the RV lot.

options.name: Chicot State Park
options.priceNote: Backcountry primitive sites $9-18/person/night first-come (6 sites); improved sites w/ water+electric $28-42 + tax, reserve online ($4.50 fee). $3/person day entrance.
options.locationNote: 3469 Chicot Park Rd, ~7 mi N of Ville Platte — roughly 5 mi off the corridor, ~14 route mi BEFORE Mamou. Coordinates approximate (south entrance).
options.legalityNote: Louisiana state park, open year-round; 198 improved sites with bathhouses.
options.cyclistIntel: THE classic Louisiana ST/USBR90 camping stop — appears in decades of journals; stopping here makes Day 10 shorter and Day 11 (to DeRidder) ~14 mi longer.
options.seasonalNote: Open year-round; hot/humid with mosquitos late Sept — improved sites near the bathhouse recommended.

options.name: Crooked Creek Recreation Area
options.priceNote: From $23/night (Good Sam listing); tent sites reported $18-25, RV $25-35. Confirm by phone.
options.locationNote: 1300 Sandy Beach Dr — on Crooked Creek Reservoir, ~14 mi NNW of Mamou via LA-13/LA-104. Off-route.
options.legalityNote: Public parish recreation area, open all year; swimming beach, restrooms/showers, both drive-in and walk-in tent sites.
options.cyclistIntel: Solid facilities but a real detour; only worth it if Chicot and the Mamou ask both fall through.

gapAdvice: Cleanest plan: end Day 10 at Chicot SP (mile ~578) instead of Mamou and absorb the extra ~14 mi into Day 11.

options.name: Merryville Museum cyclist camp
options.priceNote: Donation basis — museum + cabin/showers are 'fee on a donation basis'; leave $10-20.
options.locationNote: 628 N Railroad Ave, Merryville — just off US-190, ~18 route mi WEST (ahead) of DeRidder, ~7 mi before the Texas line. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Museum explicitly hosts cross-country cyclists: tent camping on the grounds or a raised stage area, plus a small cabin (fold-out couch, AC/heat, fridge, charging). Shower house and restrooms on site. Call/text ahead: (337) 340-1228 or (979) 864-0219.
options.cyclistIntel: A famous lower-ST stop — 'proud host of guided cross country cyclists'; ACA groups camp here; Warm Showers-affiliated. Verified current via museum site and Beauregard tourism (tents only at the camp area, 2-night max).
options.seasonalNote: Early Oct is prime hosting season.

options.name: Big Oak RV Park
options.priceNote: $20/day per Beauregard Tourist Commission — cheapest paid option in DeRidder. Tent acceptance unverified; 18 full-hookup sites, call.
options.locationNote: 631 Hwy 171 S, southern edge of DeRidder, ~1-2 mi off the endpoint. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established RV park (laundry, wifi, pool); showers not confirmed.

options.name: Beauregard Parish Civic Center RV area
options.priceNote: RV hookups $25/day, $100/week (parish tourism listing). Arena-grounds hookup pads; tents not addressed — ask when calling.
options.locationNote: 5515 Hwy 190 West — directly ON the route heading west out of DeRidder toward Merryville. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Public parish facility with published overnight RV rates; tent policy unverified.
options.seasonalNote: May be full during arena events.

options.name: Happy Days RV Resort
options.priceNote: Rate unpublished — typical DeRidder range $20-40; 30/50A full hookups, laundry. Tent policy unverified.
options.locationNote: 2918 Hwy 190 W — on the westbound route out of DeRidder. Coordinates approximate.
options.legalityNote: Established private RV resort.

gapAdvice: Strong recommendation: ride the extra 18 mi to the Merryville Museum — free/donation, tents welcome, showers, cabin option, and it sets up the Texas-line crossing next morning. If ending in DeRidder proper, call Big Oak ($20) about tents first; DeRidder's West Park has restrooms/pavilion but no sanctioned camping (city parks dept 337-462-8900 if stuck). Sam Houston Jones SP is 40+ mi south — not viable.
